pages.title: Giant Wallaby
pages.text: $(o)Protemnodon$() ($(o)Protemnodon anak$()), sometimes called the giant wallaby, was a heavy-bodied relative of today's wallabies that lived in Australia and New Guinea during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was more strongly built than living kangaroos, and some species may have moved on all fours more often than they hopped.$(br2)It lived in forests and woodlands, browsing and grazing.
